title: Korean Busan-Style Umami Dumplings
description: A comforting, mustardy, chewy dumpling dish from Busan, Korea that is easy to make and macrobiotic-friendly.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, water, salt, and cream of tartar to make the dough.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into small balls and roll them out into thin circles.
Place 1-2 tablespoons of mung bean paste in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
In a large pan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the gochujang, soy sauce, and sugar, and stir to combine.
Add the dumplings to the pan and cook for 5-7 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Serve the dumplings hot with the sauce spooned over the top.
